title: Benchmark Lab M2 — Reproducible Semantic Qualification
purpose: Make model qualification evidence semantically meaningful, reproducible, and statistically defensible before expanding model comparisons.

included: Benchmark Lab suite and scorer contracts
Semantic evaluator dispatch for generic Benchmark Lab runs
Model, runtime, suite, prompt, scorer, case, and hardware provenance capture
Qualification and comparison gates for minimum evidence quality
Representative v2 requalification evidence for existing benchmark tracks
Benchmark Lab tests and operator documentation
excluded: Automatic model swapping or global enforcement changes
New cloud or hosted evaluation judges
Public leaderboard or universal model ranking
New model/provider onboarding unrelated to provenance tests
Modification or deletion of existing approved evidence artifacts

acceptanceCriteria.description: Generic Benchmark Lab suites dispatch to a declared semantic scorer and record scorer identity/version in every run.
Schema-valid but semantically incorrect negative-control outputs fail with actionable validator codes.

evidence.note: Covers SEMANTIC_EXPECTATION_MISMATCH with a schema-valid negative control.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Qualified status requires at least 20 scored trials across at least 3 difficulty strata and at least 3 independent runs, unless a documented track-specific policy defines a different threshold with an explicit rationale; screening remains available below the gate.
Live qualification evidence records non-unknown model identity, runtime version, suite/case/prompt/scorer provenance, and hardware profile where relevant.

evidence.note: Draft-only live aggregation records llama3.2:latest, exact declared/runtime digest, Ollama 0.32.5, suite/prompt/scorer/case fingerprints, and explicit hardware-not-captured state.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Run aggregation reports per-case outcomes, repeated-trial statistics, uncertainty bounds, and critical failure counts; comparisons reject provenance mismatches.
Representative v2 evidence is generated without modifying prior approved artifacts, and all relevant Benchmark Lab plus repository validation tests pass.

evidence.note: Five independent live runs, 20 scored trials, three strata, and zero critical failures; remains draft-only.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Benchmark Lab documentation and canonical progress surfaces describe the implemented evidence boundary without broad model-quality claims.
